item.title: Western North Carolina gears up for 250th U.S. birthday celebration
item.description: Western North Carolina communities, led by volunteer groups like Buncombe 250, are planning a year-long series of events—including historical exhibits, commemorative tree plantings, community gatherings, and July 4th celebrations—to mark the U.S. semiquincentennial

item.title: Canton passes 12-month moratorium on data centers and cryptocurrency mining
item.description: Emotions were high Wednesday night at a public hearing where the Town of Canton's Board of Aldermen passed a 12-month moratorium on new data center development, server farms, and cryptocurrency mining.
